summary: Network modules run on the control node and use ansible_connection network_cli (CLI over SSH), netconf (XML over SSH) or httpapi (HTTP/HTTPS), all persistent and needing network_os; ansible_connection local with provider is deprecated.
questions: What is the difference between network_cli, netconf and httpapi?
Is ansible_connection local deprecated for network devices?
Do I need network_os for network connections?
Which connection is most common for network devices?

answer_card.title: Network connection types
answer_card.answer_md:
| ansible_connection | Protocol | Needs | Persistent |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ansible.netcommon.network_cli` | CLI over SSH | `network_os` | yes |
| `ansible.netcommon.netconf` | XML over SSH | `network_os` | yes |
| `ansible.netcommon.httpapi` | API over HTTP(S) | `network_os` | yes |
| `local` | depends on provider | `provider` | no (deprecated) |
